## What and why

Describe the user-visible problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant regression tests added/updated.
- [ ] Ruff checks and the full test suite pass.
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No private inputs, correction exports, credentials, generated archives, or native binaries included.
- [ ] Recognition/performance claims include reproducible inputs, model hash, hardware, and measurement boundaries (if applicable).

## Limitations / follow-up

Mention known trade-offs and anything intentionally out of scope.
